units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a:45">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 20b:5">B. Bath. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ סדומית</he> (sub. <cite ref="A03230"><he>ארץ</he></cite>) sea-salt, v. <cite ref="A02588"><he>אִסְתְּרוֹקָנִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 112a:5">Ḥull. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>נאכל מחמת מִלְחוֹ</he> is eaten on account of (with) the salt it has absorbed.
Keth. 66ᵇ (prov.) מ׳ ממון חֶסֶר וא״ל חסד the salt (means of preservation) of wealth is its diminution (by charitable deeds), and some say ḥesed (benevolence).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51:5">Gen. R. s. 51</cite> <he>חטאה במ׳</he> she (Lot’s wife) sinned through salt; <he>הולכת … תנו לי מ׳ מ׳</he> she went to all her neighbors and said, give me salt for we have guests; a. fr.
